title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

steps.note: Initialize pointers at ends of array.
Compare heights at left and right pointers.
Left is smaller, update leftMax and move pointer.
Water trapped at index 2 = leftMax(1) - height(0) = 1.
Loop ends as left is no longer < right.
